infrastructure.name: Video-Pipeline Control Tower & Previewer GUI
infrastructure.notes: Desktop GUI companion to the video-pipeline CLI (INI-085). Shaped end-to-end with the CEO in a Cowork session 2026-06-19; full architecture in architecture/video-pipeline/control-tower-sadd.md. The CLI stays first-class — the GUI is a schema-driven view (command library + live runner + layer previewer) that teaches the CLI rather than hiding it. Shell decided: Tauri (Rust core + WKWebView), Mac-first. Live compositing eliminated by design (the pipeline emits a flattened composite; the previewer is single-<video> source-switching), which removed the WebCodecs risk and made the app OS-agnostic. Hard subsystem = the schema-derived dependency scheduler (skip-rewire vs fail-cascade, bounded parallelism). CEO-operated tooling: code is governed, executed via narrowly-scoped Claude Code on the operating machine, OUTSIDE the director perimeter — same posture as INI-085.
